subject: Missed war room for Arkamed incident — follow-up & rescheduled bridge
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Missed war room for Arkamed incident — follow-up & rescheduled bridge

Team — quick recap: Arkamed had scheduled a war room for 09:00 PT to triage the production latency spike (SUP-4821). We had the bridge and engineer allocation ready but the customer didn't join and we didn't get notice from their side.

What I know so far:
- Customer reported 5-10s tokenization latency spikes across a single pod starting ~07:30 PT.
- Arkamed support said they would provide full traces but didn’t make the call.

Immediate asks: can Rishi confirm if we captured any tail logs from the affected pod and whether there are any obvious recent deploys or autoscaler events? Sean, can you standby for a new bridge if we get confirmation from the customer? Marissa — please own outreach to the customer and propose times.

I’ve attached a short summary (arkamed_incident_summary.pdf) and flagged SUP-4821 in Jira. Proposing to offer two windows for a new war room today: 11:30 PT or 14:00 PT.

If we can get an internal readiness check within 30m I’ll reach out to the customer with a firm link.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: arkamed_incident_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed war room for Arkamed incident — follow-up & rescheduled bridge

Neha — on it. Quick findings from initial check:
- I can see the latency spikes correlated with one node (node-17) between 07:25–07:50 PT.
- No recent model deploys in the last 48h; there was a control-plane restart at 06:58 PT that caused brief reconnections for a subset of nodes.
- I’m pulling the application-level traces now and will attach a debug bundle (debug_traces.zip) to the Jira ticket.

I prefer offering 14:00 PT as a safer window — gives us time to assemble a short RCA and the logs. Sean, can you take point on the bridge at 14:00 PT and I'll join as primary SE for debugging? Marissa, please communicate 14:00 PT as the preferred time; if they can only do earlier, let's try 11:30 PT but call me immediately so I can expedite the trace collection.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood

A couple of asks:
1) Can Redwood confirm whether you’ll have logs and traces available on the call? We need those to correlate with our DB logs.
2) Please provide a dial-in number; our security team requires an explicit meeting host IP if possible.

If 14:00 PT is confirmed I'll route the right engineers to join.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
